entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Cbi /Acb Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ambrish Singh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anurag Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Ambrish Singh Yadav, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Akhilendra Singh
holding brief of Sri Anurag Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the respondent-CBI.
2.

On 31.05.2023, after hearing the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned counsel for the respondent-CBI this Court had passed the following interim order - "1. Heard Sri Ambrish Singh Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Dharmendra Pratap Singh holding brief of Sri Anurag Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the respondent-CBI.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R./Crime No. RC0062017A0005/2017, under Sections 120-B, 409, 420, 471,
477-A IPC & Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(d) Prevention of Corruption Act,
Vishnudeo Tripathy vs State Of U.P. Thru. Cbi /Acb Lko.

3.

Regarding the applicant, it is alleged that the applicant had conspired with co-accused S.N. Chaube, and Sri Chaube had fraudulently credited Rs. 11.82 lacs in the applicant's account by diverting government Funds.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant had applied for grant of a loan under Swarn Jayanti Shahri Rozgar Yojna and by means of a letter dated 28.06.2014 issued by the Project Officer, District Urban Development Authority, Gorakhpur, a loan of Rs. 2,00,000/- was sanctioned to the applicant and it was also sanctioned that the Government would pay Rs. 50,000/- to the applicant as its contribution.
A copy of the sanctioned letter has been annexed as Annexure No. 6 to the affidavit.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that even as per the allegations levelled in the complaint itself, no disbursal was made in the name of the applicant even after sanction of the loan and the demand drafts were wrongly issued in the name of M/s New Timber House, to the co-accused Abhishek Jaiswal.
In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant has already refunded the entire amount of Rs. 11.82 lacs.
6. The matter requires consideration.

7. Let a counter affidavit be filed by the opposite party within a period of four weeks.
8.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed by the applicant within a week thereafter.

9. List this case in the week commencing 17th July, 2023.
10.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In default of any of the conditions mentioned above or it is found that applicant has obtained this order concealing any material facts, the Investigating Officer shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for vacation of this interim order."

3. Although a counter affidavit has been filed, nothing has come to light which may persuade this Court to take a view, different from the view taken while passing the aforesaid order, nor the learned counsel for the respondent-CBI has pointed out violation of any of the conditions of interim anticipatory bail committed by the applicant.
4.
In view of the aforesaid circumstances, the interim order dated 31.05.2023 is hereby made absolute and the application is allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
